purpose: Produce one corrected path or text-encoding expression while preserving target file identity.
trigger: Use when one path parse, escape, Unicode, or encoding failure is located.

inputs.name: failed_path_or_text
inputs.description: One failing path/text value, source representation, error, and intended target identity.

inputs.name: interpreter_constraints
inputs.description: Target interpreter/version, filesystem rules, encoding expectations, and allowed path APIs.

preconditions: Failure is localized to one path/text expression and target file is identifiable.
Interpreter and filesystem constraints are known.

outputs.name: corrected_path_or_encoding
outputs.description: One corrected path expression or encoding choice with target identity.

outputs.name: needs_manual_review
outputs.description: True when path meaning or target identity is not proven.

postconditions: The emitted expression states one interpreter-compatible encoding/path repair and preserves the intended target identity; execution is not claimed.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21-compatible contract reasoning; no host execution is performed by this operation.
implementation.notes: The reusable artifact is this candidate guidance contract; no executable implementation is claimed. One path/text repair only; no file operation is performed.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: Corrected spelling could point to multiple files/roles.
failure_modes.detection: Canonical resolution is not unique or base is unknown.

failure_modes.condition: Literal/encoding is unsupported by target interpreter.
failure_modes.detection: Static parse or constraint check fails.

recovery.action: Supply a stable target path/root and retry.
Choose explicit supported encoding without changing identity.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Corrected expression parses under constraints and points to same intended target.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
